title: Early birds on the Wallow
summary: A guided bird walk with a park naturalist. Binoculars to borrow.
body: No booking needed. Dress for the cold; the walk goes ahead in light rain.

title: Buckthorn pull in Cadwallow Woods
summary: Friends workday clearing invasive buckthorn below Hillcrest.
body: Gloves and loppers from the tool shed. Meet the crew leader at the kiosk.

title: Winter crew briefing
summary: Winter season briefing: plowing routes, ice checks and the warming hut.

title: Tree walk: the heritage trees
summary: The city arborist walks the tree register, from the Council Oak to the Elm Walk survivors.
body: About two miles on paved and mown paths.

title: Lantern walk around the Wallow
summary: The yearly lantern walk around the Wallow Loop, with cocoa at the Warming Hut.
body: Bring a lantern or make one at the hut from 4:00 pm. Free, and nothing to sign up for.

title: Playground bid opening
summary: Public opening of bids for the all-abilities Commons Playground.
body: Open to the public. Bids are read aloud and posted to the project page the same day.

title: Friends board meeting
summary: Friends of Cadwallow Park board meeting: playground pledge, prairie plan, 2027 workdays.

title: Ice measurement training
summary: How we drill, measure and log ice before posting the Wallow open.
body: Ice rescue sled and throw bags on the shore throughout.

title: Winter tree ID for families
summary: Learn trees by their bark, buds and shape, then find them in the garden.
body: For ages 6 and up with an adult. Drop in; no registration.

title: Snowdrop count
summary: Friends count snowdrop clumps along the south wall for the garden's records.
